about: Measured on-call-agent createIssue demand, retained issue-tracking life and published examples. Jira grants and project-scoped computed queries require handlers.

decisions.why: an action: a code or refresh token spent once, a token pair drawn from ctx.secret

decisions.why: a computed read: the sites the grant reaches

decisions.demand: The on-call SDK reads the authenticated account ID before creating its project; the Basic and OAuth life verifies the same person.
decisions.why: A read of the authenticated stored person, retaining site and read:jira-user scope checks. first-use.json's app.mjs calls jira.myself.getCurrentUser() and asserts the account's emailAddress and accountId, which leads its project; the answer carries the User the example publishes (avatarUrls at four sizes, the unexpanded groups and applicationRoles, the deprecated key and name).

decisions.demand: the site's projects
decisions.why: a computed read: paged by startAt and maxResults, isLast first-use.json's resume.mjs calls jira.projects.searchProjects and asserts the OPS project is retained.

decisions.demand: the World seeds a site's projects through the vendor's own API (the seeding rule)
decisions.why: a create: the project with Jira's default issue types and workflow first-use.json's app.mjs calls jira.projects.createProject({ key: 'OPS', ... leadAccountId }) with the account getCurrentUser answered and asserts the key.

decisions.demand: a finding filed
decisions.why: a create: the project's next key number (from its issues' history), the workflow's first status first-use.json's app.mjs makes the on-call agent's unchanged jira.issues.createIssue call (a Task with an ADF description and priority High) and asserts the OPS key and the self URL; the life's Done-on-create filing applies a transition to the new issue.

decisions.demand: an issue, its status, its labels
decisions.why: one resource's views: the fields asked first-use.json's app.mjs and resume.mjs read the ticket with jira.issues.getIssue and assert its summary, ADF text, priority, type, project and To Do status, and the 404 HttpException of a key no issue carries.

decisions.demand: labels set; priority and assignee set in triage

decisions.demand: the transitions out of an issue's status

decisions.demand: an issue reopened
decisions.why: a move the workflow allows (states.ts)

decisions.demand: cookbook/on-call-agent/agent.mjs:11
decisions.why: API tokens are created in the Atlassian account console, not Jira REST. The runtime's credentialDoor asks it at every boot for the default acme account: the token issued at the first boot is answered again, so a resume changes no state.
